# powerhmc_sriov (Data Source)

Fetches SR-IOV adapter properties from an IBM Power HMC managed system.

This data source reads the SR-IOV adapter inventory from the managed system's
I/O configuration and exposes each adapter's identity, operational state, and
physical port details. Use it to discover available adapters and ports before
creating SR-IOV logical port attachments on LPARs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch all SR-IOV adapters from the managed system.
# Use adapter_id and physical_port_id from the results when configuring
# sriov_logical_ports on a powerhmc_lpar resource.
data "powerhmc_sriov" "adapters" {
  system_name = "9040-MR9-XXXXXXXX"
}

# Select the first running SR-IOV adapter (Ethernet or RoCE).
locals {
  running_adapters = [
    for a in data.powerhmc_sriov.adapters.adapters :
    a if a.adapter_mode == "Sriov" && a.adapter_state == "Running"
  ]

  # First running adapter (used for downstream references).
  sriov_adapter = local.running_adapters[0]
}

output "sriov_adapters" {
  description = "All SR-IOV adapters on the managed system."
  value       = data.powerhmc_sriov.adapters.adapters
}

output "first_running_adapter_id" {
  description = "adapter_id of the first running SR-IOV adapter."
  value       = local.sriov_adapter.adapter_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `system_name` (String) Name of the managed system as shown in the HMC.

### Read-Only

- `adapters` (Attributes List) List of SR-IOV adapters found on the managed system. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--adapters))

<a id="nestedatt--adapters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `adapters`

Read-Only:

- `adapter_id` (Number) Numeric adapter ID used to reference this adapter in logical-port requests.
- `adapter_mode` (String) Operational mode of the adapter. Possible values: `Sriov`, `Dedicated`, `ForceDedicated`.
- `adapter_state` (String) Runtime state of the adapter. Possible values: `Running`, `NotConfigured`.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the adapter card (e.g. `PCIe3 2 PORT 25/10 Gb NIC&ROCE SFP28 ADAPTER`).
- `ethernet_physical_ports` (Attributes List) Pure Ethernet and CNA physical ports on this adapter (PortType = `Ethernet` or `Cna`). Empty for `Dedicated`/`NotConfigured` adapters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--adapters--ethernet_physical_ports))
- `is_functional` (Boolean) Whether the adapter is currently functional.
- `maximum_huge_dma_logical_ports` (Number) Maximum number of huge-DMA logical ports supported by the adapter.
- `maximum_logical_ports_supported` (Number) Total number of logical ports the adapter can host across all physical ports.
- `personality` (String) Adapter personality string.
- `physical_location` (String) Physical location code of the adapter card (e.g. `U78D3.001.WZS078A-P1-C11`).
- `roce_physical_ports` (Attributes List) RoCE physical ports on this adapter (PortType = `RoCE`). Empty for `Dedicated`/`NotConfigured` adapters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--adapters--roce_physical_ports))
- `sriov_adapter_id` (Number) The numeric SR-IOV adapter ID.

<a id="nestedatt--adapters--ethernet_physical_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `adapters.ethernet_physical_ports`

Read-Only:

- `allocated_capacity` (String) Percentage of port capacity currently allocated to logical ports (e.g. `0.0%`).
- `configured_connection_speed` (String) Configured connection speed (e.g. `Auto`, `E10Gbps`, `E25Gbps`).
- `configured_ethernet_logical_ports` (Number) Number of Ethernet logical ports currently configured on this port.
- `configured_fcoe_logical_ports` (Number) Number of FCoE logical ports currently configured on this port.
- `configured_max_ethernet_logical_ports` (Number) Operator-configured cap on Ethernet logical ports for this port (`ConfiguredMaxEthernetLogicalPorts`; CNA ports).
- `configured_max_fcoe_logical_ports` (Number) Maximum FCoE logical ports configured on this port (CNA ports only).
- `configured_mtu` (String) Configured MTU size (e.g. `E_9000` = 9000 bytes, `E_1500` = 1500 bytes).
- `configured_options` (List of String) Active port option flags. Encodes Port Switch Mode (`Veb`/`Vepa`), Flow Control (`receiveFlowControl`, `transmitFlowControl`), and LLDP state (`AdapterLldpForPortDisabled`).
- `current_connection_speed` (String) Negotiated connection speed at runtime (e.g. `E10Gbps`, `Unknown`).
- `is_converged` (Boolean) Whether this is a Converged Network Adapter (CNA) port (`true`) or a pure Ethernet port (`false`).
- `label` (String) User-assigned label for this port.
- `link_status` (Boolean) Whether the physical link is currently up.
- `location_code` (String) Physical location code of the port (e.g. `U78D3.001.WZS078A-P1-C11-T1`).
- `mac_address` (String) Hardware MAC address of the port.
- `max_supported_ethernet_logical_ports` (Number) Hardware maximum Ethernet logical ports this port can host (`MaxSupportedEthernetLogicalPorts`).
- `max_supported_fcoe_logical_ports` (Number) Maximum FCoE logical ports this port can host (CNA ports only).
- `maximum_allowed_eth_macs` (Number) Maximum number of allowed Ethernet MAC addresses.
- `maximum_allowed_eth_vlans` (Number) Maximum number of allowed Ethernet VLANs.
- `maximum_diagnostics_logical_ports` (Number) Maximum number of diagnostic logical ports supported.
- `maximum_port_vlan_id` (Number) Maximum port VLAN ID (PVID) supported by this port.
- `maximum_promiscuous_logical_ports` (Number) Maximum number of promiscuous logical ports supported.
- `maximum_vlan_id` (Number) Maximum VLAN ID supported by this port.
- `minimum_ethernet_capacity_granularity` (Number) Smallest capacity increment (%) configurable for an Ethernet logical port.
- `minimum_port_vlan_id` (Number) Minimum port VLAN ID (PVID) supported by this port.
- `minimum_vlan_id` (Number) Minimum VLAN ID supported by this port.
- `physical_port_id` (Number) Zero-based port index on the adapter.
- `port_logical_port_limit` (Number) Maximum total logical ports allowed on this physical port.
- `port_type` (String) The type of the SR-IOV port.
- `sub_label` (String) User-assigned sub-label for this port.
